title: How to write product descriptions that answer buyers and sell
seoTitle: How to write product descriptions that sell
description: Write product descriptions from real facts and buyer questions. Get a fact sheet, a scannable layout, product page SEO basics and AI prompts to copy.
lede: Product descriptions sell when they answer the questions buyers ask before they pay. Start with verified facts, collect genuine buyer questions, support each benefit with evidence and make the page easy to scan. This guide gives you the method, a fact sheet, SEO basics and prompts for your AI.
